Draconic Quirk.name: Draconic Quirk
Draconic Quirk.description:
🐉 Scales, horns, a muscular tail, and clawed hands are yours every day. Take a deep breath and the plates on your chest glow like a furnace door.

🌱 At the start your scales can turn a glancing cut and one short exhale sends fire two meters.
📈 With training: tail-assisted lifts, horn catches, a shield for a fallen teammate, and a charging turn behind a fan of flame.
⚠️ After each flame breath, spend one full turn holding a fresh breath before firing again. Cold slows your joints. Your wingless body stays grounded.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell. If chosen, your throat shines through your collar before you breathe fire.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ryukyu (Dragon) for the dragon physique and Mashirao Ojiro (Tail) for balance.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Blocking +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Shingle Shrug, Kiln Puff
🛡️ Resists: slashing
Draconic Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: Permanent adult-sized dragon build. Claws grip ledges, scales turn glancing cuts, short chest-fed breath reaches two meters, four with training. Limits: Each flame use needs a full breath-hold turn before another. Cold stiffens joints. Scale seams yield and the horn spread needs clearance. No wings or flight. Quirk Strain: light: Shingle Shrug, Kiln Puff; moderate: Tailstand Lift, Crown Catch, Cliffside Clutch; heavy: Scale Awning, Turntable Tail, Furnace Ribbon, Vaultback Brace, Crestline Drive; severe: Redcrest Wheel. Type: Mutant. Law: Horns and claws are ordinary features. Breathing fire into a crowd risks an assault charge. Look: Overlapping scales lift above the sternum on the inhale.
